import_vasp_flags_for_slab_optimization: import VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure slab and adslab VASP optimization runs
import_bulk_vasp_flags_for_crystal_optim: import BULK_VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure bulk crystal structure VASP optimization runs
import_solvent_base_flags_for_solvation: import SOLVENT_BASE_FLAGS dictionary to configure solvent-related VASP calculation parameters
import_solvent_bulk_vasp_flags: import SOLVENT_BULK_VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure solvent bulk VASP optimization runs
import_relax_and_md_flags: import RELAX_FLAGS and MD_FLAGS dictionaries to configure quick relaxation or molecular dynamics VASP runs
